evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Not present. Rep skips straight from confirmation into probing without framing time, dependability promise, or waiting for a yes.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Move date: 'Saturday October 17th'; From: '10204 Plus drive'; To: '8677. FM 1553. Landlord, Texas'; Size: '2600. Square footage' and 'two story house'; Additional stop: 'Just A to B'
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked after initial probing: 'aside from the price or the quote miss Heather, I would like to know what are you most worried about for this upcoming move? Do you have any specific concerns?' — but only after packing and logistics questions.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised concern: 'just making sure we made the right choice.' Rep acknowledged but did not probe deeper with 'tell me more' or follow-up.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection summary offered. Rep moved directly to estimate anchor after concern acknowledgment.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provided typical range: 'two trucks, five movers and the whole day like no, maybe 78 hours' — this is a time/resource anchor but pricing itself is deferred to the walkthrough. No personalization to this customer's specific concerns.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: No explicit ask. Call ends with walkthrough scheduling, not a booking close.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_offer: Correctly offered: 'I would like to do a quick virtual walkthrough with you. In that way I can better assess the size of your move and give you a more accurate estimate. The virtual walkthrough probably takes five to ten minutes.' Proper routing for 2,600 sq ft home.

top_strength: Rep correctly identified the move size (2,600 sq ft) and properly routed to a virtual walkthrough rather than attempting an on-call estimate, following the script's 1,800+ sq ft branching logic.
coaching_note: Section 1 skipped the time-boxed quid pro quo framing entirely — lead with 'This will take about 10 to 15 minutes and you can walk away with a quote you can depend on, does that sound good?' before moving into discovery, even on walkthrough-routed calls.
booking_note: Virtual walkthrough was scheduled for 4:45 PM via video call, though customer asked to consult with husband first and said 'we'll call you all' to confirm timing.
